scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently --names client,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w client" "npm run start:dev -w server"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:e2e -w server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test
